# weir service

<!-- Generated by `weir reference`. Do not edit: change the help text in src/main.rs and regenerate. -->

Run the daemon as a service that starts at login (with Homebrew, use `brew services`).

```text
Run the daemon as a service that starts at login (with Homebrew, use `brew services`)

Usage: weir service [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

Commands:
  install    Register the daemon with launchd (macOS) or systemd (Linux) and start it
  uninstall  Stop the daemon and remove the service
  start      Start the daemon now
  stop       Stop the daemon until the next login
  status     Say whether the service is installed and the daemon is running

Options:
      --json
          Machine-readable output

  -q, --quiet
          Print errors only

  -h, --help
          Print help
```
